name: Publish
why: A plugin or skill, from its first SKILL.md to a listing in Anthropic's directory
ideal: Skills follow Anthropic's authoring rules, beat no plugin on Haiku, Sonnet and Opus, stay cheap always-on, and the portal blocks or holds nothing.

sources.title: Claude Code: extend Claude with skills
Claude Code: measure plugin cost and usage
Claude Code: test plugins with evals

steps.name: Write
steps.rule: Skill names and descriptions follow Anthropic's authoring rules: third person, and saying when to use the skill.

steps.name: Trim
steps.rule: Names and descriptions that load every session stay short, so the plugin's always-on cost stays low.

steps.name: Test
steps.rule: Each skill has three eval cases whose Skill grader proves the skill fired.

steps.name: Measure
steps.rule: Each skill scores above the no-plugin baseline on Haiku, Sonnet and Opus in claude plugin eval.

steps.name: Validate
steps.rule: The developer portal's validation finds nothing that blocks submission or stops it.

steps.name: Clear
steps.rule: Nothing is held for a reviewer, so a new version goes live without waiting.
